name: Cloudflare Universal WordPress Settings Template
description: Universal Cloudflare configuration template optimized for WordPress websites (compatible with Free and Paid plans)

waf_rules.description: 3. Managed challenge on wp-login.php and /wp-admin/, except admin-ajax.php and admin-post.php
waf_rules.expression: ((http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-admin/") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-login.php")) and not (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php") and not (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-admin/admin-post.php")

waf_rules.description: 4. Block sensitive file types (.sql, .bak, .log, .env, .old, .tar), except under /wp-content/uploads/
waf_rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path.extension in {"sql" "bak" "log" "env" "old" "tar"} or (http.request.uri.path contains "/.env")) and not (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-content/uploads/")

waf_rules.description: 5. Block every .php file outside WordPress entry points, plus empty user agent
waf_rules.expression: ((http.request.uri.path.extension eq "php" or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".php")) and not (http.request.uri.path in {"/index.php" "/wp-login.php" "/wp-comments-post.php" "/wp-signup.php" "/wp-activate.php"}) and not (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-admin/")) or (http.user_agent eq "")

rate_limiting_rules.description: Rate limiting: POST /wp-login.php (5 req/10s per IP, blocked for 10s)
rate_limiting_rules.expression: http.request.method eq "POST" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/wp-login.php" or http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-login.php")
